subject.title: fix(acp): background Codex ACP turns fail hard on transient pre-output Internal error

question: Does the current Codex ACP implementation establish that the top-level `Internal error` and closed-transport messages used here are transient pre-output failures that may safely receive one fresh-handle retry?
rationale: Repository policy requires direct inspection of the sibling Codex source before a Codex-related verdict; that dependency contract determines whether the message classifier is appropriately narrow.

options.title: Verify and proceed
options.body: Inspect the Codex ACP client and transport error paths, refresh the current head, and merge if they support the proposed bounded retry contract.

options.title: Narrow the classifier
options.body: If Codex source shows any selected message can represent a deterministic failure, restrict matching to the proven transient error form before merge.

recommendation.title: Verify and proceed
recommendation.body: Inspect the Codex ACP client and transport error paths, refresh the current head, and merge if they support the proposed bounded retry contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposal and its supplied runtime proof identify the intended error boundary, making the author the best available contact to help locate the exact Codex contract for reviewer verification.
